summary: Structure-only review: the compact optical train now has six rail-mounted carriers with visible support arms/bearings, a shared front carriage, four rear hinges and eight two-arm linkage supports. Measured 16 link endpoints stay within 6.1e-8 units; 24 rail sockets remain coaxial; bearing/track radial gap is .001 and minimum axial engagement .08 across static deployment samples. Rear optical train stays seated during automatic opening to preserve its mount; manual separation still spreads all seven groups coherently. Existing front metal occluders still hide part of the stack and must be physically opened in the form pass. Glass is coarse clay, panel profile is faceted, and final curvature/finish/motion remain unaccepted. 152736 model triangles and 84 calls; sampled self-intersection and both turntables pass, with 24 undecided sampled vertices disclosed. Generic attachment tool reports zero applicable anchors; actual rig socket/geometry measurements and tamper-sensitive tests supply contact evidence.

features.notes: Seven fixed groups and cell correspondence retained in the compact axial layout; final glass profiles still pending.
Visible rail sleeves/support arms and retained hinge linkages; measured physical endpoints, bearing radii and axial overlap pass the static deployment contract.
Original exterior dimensions and IDs retained; front carriage and independent focus pivot support future coordinated motion. This is hierarchy acceptance, not completed animation acceptance.
